scope: Native contrast-envelope measurements using the shared symbol tool, with fixed cohort thresholds and no per-scan alignment. Remove one native pixel of known 3 × 3 kernel support per side; this is an outline envelope, not dark-ink bounds. Renderer envelopes use exact matched blank-face subtraction and a separate low difference threshold sweep, because the current frame can touch the symbol. Thin strokes and background texture can make segmentation unreliable; keep all flags and do not treat unstable measurements as fitting evidence. Frozen eleven calibration cards for variant selection; full-set measurement only after selection.
